posts.caption:
A $1,400 quote goes out. On day 0 a message checks it arrived, on day 2 another says the timing still works, and on day 5 a last one says the quote stays open. Then the customer writes back asking to book this week.

In most shops that follow-up waits for someone to have a free minute and to remember which quotes are still open. Here it goes out on a schedule in your name and stops as soon as the customer replies, yes or no.

Link in bio if you want to see it on your own quotes.

#automation #durhamregion #smallbusinessautomation #sales #followup
